summary: AWS 15th re:Invent Conference Session Booking |  AWS Events MCP
description: Cloud Del Norte Reserved seating for Amazon Web Services' re:Invent conference opens October 6 in two waves. To ensure easier access across time zones, AWS is opening seats for reservation in two waves this year. Half the seats will open at 10AM El Paso time and the other half at 6PM PT. Join us as we view the schedule
